benchmark_metadata.study_title: A complete diploid human genome benchmark for personalized genomics
benchmark_metadata.authors: Nancy F. Hansen, Nathan Dwarshuis, Hyun Joo Ji, Arang Rhie, Hailey Loucks, Glennis A. Logsdon, Mitchell R. Vollger, Adam M. Phillippy, et al.
benchmark_metadata.consortium: Telomere-to-Telomere (T2T) Consortium, Human Pangenome Reference Consortium (HPRC), Genome in a Bottle (GIAB)
benchmark_metadata.benchmark_scope: Telomere-to-telomere diploid ground truth for all 46 chromosomes (diploid autosomes + chrX + chrY)

key_complex_variant_truth_loci.clinical_impact: Loss-of-function star alleles causing poor metabolizer phenotype for tamoxifen, codeine, tramadol, and beta-blockers.

key_complex_variant_truth_loci.event_type: 3.85 Mb Inversion Flanked by REPD/REPB Segmental Duplications
key_complex_variant_truth_loci.clinical_impact: Polymorphic inversion predisposing to 8p23.1 deletion syndrome during meiotic non-allelic homologous recombination (NAHR).
H1/H2 haplotype defining neurodegenerative disease susceptibility (Progressive Supranuclear Palsy, Corticobasal Degeneration).

key_complex_variant_truth_loci.locus: SMN1 / SMN2 Spinal Muscular Atrophy Locus
key_complex_variant_truth_loci.clinical_impact: Differentiates functional SMN1 from modifier SMN2; crucial for SMA diagnosis and antisense oligonucleotide (Nusinersen/Spinraza) therapy.

key_complex_variant_truth_loci.locus: LPA Kringle IV Type 2 (KIV-2) Tandem Repeat
key_complex_variant_truth_loci.clinical_impact: Inverse correlation between KIV-2 copy number and plasma Lipoprotein(a) concentration, a causal risk factor for cardiovascular disease.

key_complex_variant_truth_loci.locus: C4A / C4B MHC Class III Locus
key_complex_variant_truth_loci.event_type: 32 kb Segmental Deletion with HERV-K Insertion
key_complex_variant_truth_loci.clinical_impact: Complement factor C4 copy number and retroviral integration linked to schizophrenia susceptibility and autoimmune diseases (SLE).
Glucocerebrosidase deficiency and Parkinson's disease genetic risk.
Constitutive kinase activation in CML / Ph+ ALL; sensitive to Imatinib, Dasatinib, Ponatinib.
APL diagnostic hallmark; highly sensitive to targeted All-Trans Retinoic Acid (ATRA) and Arsenic Trioxide (ATO).
